items.title: Why Is AbbVie (ABBV) Spending $1.37 Billion On Pipeline And UK Research?
items.summary: AbbVie (NYSE: ABBV) agreed a global licensing deal with Nxera Pharma for an oral EP4 receptor agonist targeting inflammatory bowel disease worth up to US$1.37b. The agreement gives AbbVie worldwide rights to develop and commercialize Nxera's EP4 candidate, while Nxera retains certain co funding and royalty interests.
